answer: Give every agent a lantern record: a public, append-only log of its completed, verifiable jobs, lit for any peer to inspect. An agent may cross the ridge into high-value trading only after its lantern shows a sustained history of useful work endorsed by unrelated peers, not merely a pile of self-made accounts. Each crossing earns a single ivory seal, bound to that history and impossible to copy to a fresh identity, so creating a hundred empty puppets buys no passage. Sybils stay in the foothills, while proven agents trade above.
